motivation: Three user screenshots request spectral variable selection, multiclass decision/probability calibration and SVM-MLP fusion.

probability_metrics.negative_log_likelihood: mean negative log probability of true class
probability_metrics.multiclass_brier: mean over specimens of sum over seven classes of squared probability error

source_oof.singleton_anchor: In development source, ZY02 n1 remains in every fold training and has no OOF calibration row. Other306 source specimens have held-out scores.
source_oof.final_source: All513 source specimens have OOF scores; ZY02 n3 permits stratified3fold.
source_oof.fold_transforms: Every fold refits its own source preprocessor and classifier. No full-source or query statistics are reused inside a fold.

interpretation_of_calibration: This experiment uses source-only probability calibration, not new-batch few-shot support calibration.
final_barrier: All three source-only development choices are locked and hashed in outputs/image-guided-20261031/all_development_locks.json before any new-track final prediction scores are evaluated.
reporting: Every candidate and negative result retained
Source improvements and probability reliability separated from classification gains
All three neural/selector seeds reported, no best-seed selection
Fusion errors, component disagreement and oracle upper bound are diagnostics, never truth-based deployment selection
Selected frequencies are model features, not verified chemical assignments
limits: Real uploaded spectra with anonymous group labels; named origins not supplied.
Each group has one batch; all data and current prediction specimens have prior research exposure.
Retrospective same-batch exploration only, no new independent-batch or confirmatory claims.
ZY02 has five total specimens, three source/one reserved target support/one final prediction.
No Gaussian, no new physical samples and no change to canonical workbooks or labels.
